reviewed_boundaries: Pins the source, selected CI/documentation/provider-probe runs, exactly three changed Identity product files, base-file preimages, and selected-file hashes before preparing the overlay.

Compares current release manifest dependencies, migrations, schema compatibility, and all contracts except the separately installed/unconsumed S05 store-check contract; verifies all current Identity files and requires only the three approved Identity file changes.

Creates a new release overlay with only the selected product files copied; unchanged material is referenced from the old release. The existing venv is referenced, with no migration or dependency installation.

Prepare checks all four readiness endpoints, current pointer/process binding, protected service invocations, environment-file hashes, root-owned paths, disk reserve, inode floor, and a fresh target/receipt before activation.

Activation rechecks the prepared manifest and snapshot, changes only identity-current, restarts only alisa-identity@stage.service, verifies the live process cwd and release readiness, and checks other pointers, service invocations, profile, and config hashes remain unchanged.

Recovery is armed before pointer replacement and restores only the prior identity-current target before restarting Identity; previous releases are retained. Existing finite rollout locks are acquired non-blocking.
operational_note: A hard kill during prepare can leave an incomplete inactive target. The script refuses to overwrite an existing target; inspect the private receipt and target before any reviewed recovery, and do not blindly rerun.
review_limits: Static read-only review only; installer was not executed and no host calls were made.
This approval covers the declared Identity overlay procedure only; post-install browser confirmation and CI completion remain separate gates.
